theme.title: Rotation: Value/Defensives → Growth
theme.summary: Materials (+1.73%) and Communication Svcs (+1.72%) led the market today, while Energy (-2.15%) and Utilities (-0.24%) brought up the rear. Growth sectors outpaced the rest, averaging +1.31% versus +0.47% for defensives and +0.47% for value, consistent with risk appetite favoring higher-beta names. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 +0.33%, Dow +1.08%, Nasdaq +0.08% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps bucked the broader trend, with the Russell 2000 up +1.38%, outperforming large caps. The VIX fell 2.31% to 16.46, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold added 0.44% to $4,184.10, crude oil was little changed at $96.13, and bitcoin gained 0.70% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
